name: SeAH Holdings Corporation
summary: Established in 1960 and based in Seoul, South Korea, SeAH Holdings Corporation is a global enterprise primarily engaged in the steel materials sector. Its extensive product range features various steel pipes, such as welded carbon, stainless, and titanium variants, alongside galvanized and pre-painted steel sheets. The company further specializes in manufacturing special steel products, heavy forgings, and diverse stainless steel items, including wire rods, round bars, seamless pipes, and flat and square bars. SeAH also produces cold heading quality wires and cold drawn bars, which are crucial components for industries like automotive, electronics, industrial machinery, shipbuilding, and construction. Beyond its foundational steel offerings, SeAH supplies fluid components for both automobiles and home appliances, various types of specialized steel sheets, and a comprehensive selection of welding products, from flux cored wires and electrodes to advanced welding machines and automation systems. It additionally manufactures turbo compressors and provides engineering services tailored for steelmaking and plant facilities. The corporation is a key producer of molybdenum alloy products, such as molybdenum oxide powder and briquette, and FeMo, all vital for the steel industry. Furthermore, it supplies specialized stainless steel wires, rack bars, and pinion shafts specifically for vehicles. SeAH Holdings also extends its operations into digital infrastructure, delivering software and hardware solutions encompassing system, network, and media integration, alongside corporate digital solution development. Complementing these activities, the company offers broad logistics services, including transportation, warehouse management, international and domestic shipping brokerage, and steel product processing and dispatch.
